decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 2 - All advertisements displays, and any site used for the display of advertisements shall be maintained in a clean and tidy condition to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 3 - Any structure or hoarding erected or used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a safe condition.
Condition : 4 - No advertisement is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant planning permission.

Condition : 5 - No advertisment shall be sited or displayed so as to obscure, or hinder, the ready interpretation of any road sign, railway sign or aid to navigation by water or air so as to otherwise render hazardous the use of any highway, railway, waterway ( including any coastal waters) or aerodrome (civil or military).
Condition : 6 - The sign shall be static only, with no moving or apparently moving images, devices, wording or emblems or changing light patterns.
Condition : 7 - Lighting levels shall not exceed levels set out by the Institute of Lighting Engineers Guidance Notes for the Reduction of Light Pollution.

Condition : 8 - Before the signs hereby approved are installed, the existing vinyl banner on the railings in front of the site and the existing fascia sign above the ground floor entrance to the site shall be removed from the premises
description: Installation of one internally illuminated fascia sign to building and one internally illuminated fascia sign to entrance canopy of building in respect of the Gym.
